title: Your password “expires today”
scenario: An email with the school logo says your student password expires today and you will lose access to assignments unless you reset it before 6 p.m. The button opens a page that looks exactly like the school login.

answers.A: Close the email and open the school portal from your normal bookmark or school website to check for a reset notice.
answers.B: Ask school IT or a teacher through a known channel whether passwords are expiring today.
answers.C: Reset it through the email because losing assignment access would be worse than being cautious.

explanation: Phishing pages often copy real school branding. The safest move is to start from the portal you already trust.
proTip: Type or tap your own trusted route, not theirs.
